book.name: Mareko
book.title: Mareko Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Marekoꞌa Mirihiro

content: Kuru Neḡa Fahe Ḡuzuhiteꞌe moneo Ḡoeriro
Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa mode buarotene, ane tahiꞌa ꞌahoganiꞌa niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, ḡianoꞌi. Ne hadiḡa niduꞌaꞌe horeḡa hune! Ne iraḡa niduꞌaꞌe manoḡa tauḡi!”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡa ne boro ꞌahi niduꞌa horoneꞌehe? Ne ꞌahi niduꞌa fahe ḡuzuhiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa aradu hadini ꞌahoganiꞌa hadi ꞌahoga rana mene radiꞌuma.”
Aduga zu Sauꞌaniꞌa Fureraꞌuma
Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa moneḡudune Olivi Maḡano ehoreꞌeteꞌea, Petero, Iakobo, Ioane ebu Andereaꞌa sifu ḡadiniro,
“Eme efoꞌi. Eꞌeguḡaꞌe naniꞌa fureraꞌuma? Ebu eꞌeguḡaniꞌa nariga fureranateꞌe madaḡanoꞌe nagi haḡai nu badeḡaniꞌa ibite fureraꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa zae mene soꞌosoꞌozifine tohutohoꞌi.
Vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa eḡe niḡano aradu 'Eꞌe Keriso,' rae raꞌenaꞌa, vaze ḡehaḡa soꞌosoꞌoziꞌuma.
Zaꞌe utiꞌa fureraroteꞌe hariḡa zu fureraꞌuma rae raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa nunu egoꞌidene, zamazeꞌa ago ꞌadaꞌadazoꞌi. Eꞌeguḡaniꞌa hube hune ibite fureraꞌuma, rehano mada ḡonagaꞌe ꞌize mene ariꞌuma.

Haba ꞌahoganiꞌa haba ꞌahoga teite utitiꞌuma zu gavamani ꞌahoganiꞌa gavamani ꞌahoga teite utitiꞌuma. Haba nunu zamaḡano habaꞌa borofe hagariꞌuma zu zagaꞌa hiaꞌuma. Eꞌeguḡa niduꞌaꞌe ene ꞌizema fureranogano gigiꞌaniꞌa ḡadahe fureruꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.

Zaꞌe tohutohoꞌi. Vazeꞌa zae oboze teadu kotao ohoziꞌuma ebu zeḡe nuꞌonuꞌo neḡano masiziꞌuma. Eḡe uꞌano, zaꞌe gavamani azaḡa zu kini azaḡa mazao tutuze onamadu edauꞌenaꞌa, eḡe hari manoḡa zeḡe zamao rae fureniꞌuma.
Ebu hari manoḡaꞌe habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa niduꞌa mazao ibite harame huniꞌuma.

Vazeꞌa kotao za oboze toꞌidene, nagini rae ḡoeriteꞌe moneo zamaze ago ibite adudanoꞌi. Eꞌe madaḡano za nougenouge rae ḡoeriteꞌe moneo ihoziꞌuma ebu ihoziteꞌe ḡoeꞌa idunaḡano reꞌuma, mazaḡa ḡoere aꞌe mene zae mazaonoꞌo, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa reꞌuma.
Negoḡaniꞌa negoḡa revohanadu runeo tuḡuniꞌuma, moganiꞌa ubuga revohanadu runeo tuḡuniꞌuma ebu ubudezeꞌa vize moze agirozeadu runeo tuḡuziꞌuma.
Eḡe uꞌano vaze niduꞌa za heꞌeheꞌeziꞌuma. Rehano iniu edau gigaru onamo ḡonaga meiteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡabone hidiꞌuma.”
Aduga Boro Bagaḡa

“Haba sausauneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa sauꞌa bagaḡaniꞌa mene edatiteꞌe habaꞌano edauꞌeteꞌe zaeꞌa horoniteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma (ꞌadi meꞌodeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, ḡoere huga ꞌadi faine ederoꞌi). Eꞌe madaḡano Iudea habaꞌano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe maḡa ferau itoꞌi.
Ne enogano
radiuꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡauḡa mouga veize ne zamaḡa ago diuḡoꞌi.
Mebao hiheꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe dabua mouga veize ago bare onamoꞌi.
Eꞌe madaḡano ahiꞌeta roḡaeḡa zu nune hina ene guraḡa ḡubuzeꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡaꞌe feranoga mene idaḡa radu aduga boro hidiꞌuma!
ꞌUguḡaniꞌa irugu madaḡano
mene fureranoga veize kuranoꞌi.
Mazaḡa eꞌe madaḡano vaze niduꞌa aduga boro hune hidiꞌuma. Badiꞌaꞌa ḡadaheḡano ḡau niduꞌa haḡairoteꞌeanoꞌo onao izidi, aduga ꞌuguḡaniꞌa mene fureraro ebu vesuꞌu zuni mene bare fureraꞌuma.
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa eꞌe madaḡa mene futufine, vaze tiba zuni mene ḡabode radiꞌuma. Rehano ani aneꞌa ohozadu zamaziroteꞌe azaḡa veize eꞌe madaḡa futufiro.
Eꞌe madaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa zinaꞌa, 'Ḡianoꞌi, Kerisoꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe!' ga 'Ḡianoꞌi, aniꞌe ꞌomo eꞌe!' rae zoꞌidene, eꞌe ḡoeꞌa ago mae ḡihinoꞌi.
Mazaḡa ḡuriro kerisoḡa zu ḡuriro peroveta azaḡaniꞌa fureranadu haḡai nu badeḡa zu haḡai gigiꞌa haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, vaze soꞌoziꞌuma. Ze idaḡa reine, Badiꞌaꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa zuni soꞌoziꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo za tohutohoꞌi. Eꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ꞌizema fureranogano eḡeꞌa ḡau niduꞌa zae ibite ihozeha.”
Vaze Ubuganiꞌa Ariꞌuma
“Rehano aduga madaḡaniꞌa hauḡine,
Eꞌe madaḡano ze Vaze Ubuganiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa boro zu agaḡa boro hune madu ḡoze hina areꞌeteꞌe horoniꞌuma.
Ebu aniꞌa ane tuḡure viga ḡehaḡa tuḡuziꞌuma, ebu zeḡeꞌa haba ḡonaganonoꞌo adure ḡonagano, haba niduꞌa zamaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa nuꞌoziꞌuma.”
Figi Ireḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
“Figi ireḡa ḡianadu ꞌahi ederoꞌi. Ezaganiꞌa butiru itadu rouḡaniꞌa udufaꞌoga horoneꞌetene, zaꞌe irugu madaḡaniꞌa haniteha rae edereꞌohe.
Eꞌe teige, ꞌahiguḡaniꞌa fureranoga horonoꞌidene, Vaze Ubugaꞌe zae ibiheta uhiḡano rae ederoꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, izidi egaꞌe mene hauḡiꞌuma, onamo ꞌahiguḡa niduꞌa fureraꞌuma.
Adure zu rahaꞌe hauḡiꞌuma, rehano eḡe ḡoereꞌe mene hune hauḡiꞌuma.”
Eꞌe Madaḡaꞌe Aḡuꞌa
“Rehano vazeni ꞌahoga zuni ꞌuguḡaniꞌa fureratiteꞌe madaḡaꞌe aḡuꞌa. Adureo tuḡure viga ebu Badiꞌa Ubuga zuni aḡuꞌa, rehano Moga daꞌo edeḡa.
Tohutohe radoꞌi, mazaḡa zaꞌe aḡuꞌa, eꞌe madaḡaniꞌa naniꞌa ariꞌuma.

Aꞌe vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa haba faḡa onameꞌeteꞌe hariḡa ꞌahoga heuḡa. Ani iḡuneꞌetene, tuḡureḡa azaḡa huzadu ane ḡau niduꞌa faine taufoꞌi rae raꞌohe, zeḡe tibatiba gau tibatiba ziniꞌohe, ebu ibiheta taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe faine ḡianoꞌi rae raꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo tohutohoꞌi, mazaḡa za aḡuꞌa, ne Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa noꞌe madaḡano naniꞌa bare ariꞌuma. Aꞌe ḡorava oheꞌano, ga ohere nemanema, ga irara oheꞌano kokorokuꞌa ugauꞌeteꞌe madaḡano, ga oheredauꞌe za aḡuꞌa.
Aniꞌa tabara aradu za bazuna mene horozifine zaꞌe evatoꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa za ziꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe vaze niduꞌa ziꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa: Evate radoꞌi!”

footnotes.text: nahune madaḡano. Isaraela habaꞌano nahune madaḡaꞌe nahune boro zu irugu boro radu vazeꞌa ragavogaꞌe riḡa.
